commits.name: Commit-0
commits.content:
# image_sizes: (224,224)
image_sizes:
  primary: [224, 224]

# Directory Paths
data_root_dir: "./datasets/LIBERO_RLDS"
dataset_name: "libero_10_no_noops"

# Model & Device Configuration
vqvae_config_path: "models/vla_vq/action_vqvae_config"
device: "cuda"

# VQVAE Parameters
window_size: 10
image_window_size: 1
vq_layer_group: 4
n_latent_dims: 128
checkpoint_path: "./checkpoints/action_tokenizer_weight/all_data_vq.pth"
use_action_type_pe: true
use_time_pe: true

# Training Parameters
SEED: 1
wandb_enable: true
wandb_name: "MaskVLA"
world_size: 0
local_rank: -1
rank: 0
cuda_device: 0

output_dir: "run/experiments/{:%H-%M-%S}/"
batch_size: 16
max_epochs: 50
max_steps: 30000
shuffle_buffer_size: 100000
image_aug: true
learning_rate: 1e-4
gamma: 0.1
gradient_accumulation_steps: 1
grad_norm: 200
bar_steps: 1
log_steps: 10
save_steps: 10000

# Checkpoint
checkpoint: null
checkpoint_strict_load: false
resume_training: false
resume_encoder_only: false

# VLA Parameters
code_dim: 512
latent_dim: 512
img_latent_dim: 512
ff_size: 2048
num_layers: 6
num_heads: 8
dropout: 0.2
cond_drop_prob: 0.1
clip_version: "ViT-B/32"
num_tokens: 256        # logits维度 / VQ codebook size
mask_type: "1D"
step_unroll: 1
vq_action_dim: 4

# Eval Parameters
task_suite_name: "libero_10"
num_steps_wait: 10
num_trials_per_task: 50
run_id_note: null
local_log_dir: "./experiments/logs"
seed: 7
image_history_size: 1
model_family: "maskvla"
vla_checkpoint: "./run/experiments/16-37-57/ckpts/model_step_20001.pt"

# Inference Parameters
timesteps: 20           # Number of denoising steps for MaskGIT sampling
cond_scale: 3           # Classifier-free guidance scale (>1 means stronger conditioning)
temperature: 1.0        # Sampling temperature
topk_filter_thres: 0.9  # Top-k filtering threshold
gsample: false          # Whether to use Gumbel-Softmax sampling

# Wandb for eval
wandb_project: "MaskVLA_Eval"
wandb_entity: "YOUR_WANDB_ENTITY"
